english: The porcelain specter hangs delicately in the air before the pillar.
Her face is lit up by the dungeon glow.
Cleric.
Snell.
Yo.
The goblin shoots her a finger gun, before quickly retracting it and taking a step back.
He finds her horrifying.
Hello, Ettir.
What are you doing down here?
(Wave.)
Yeah, he mutters from the back.
I'm just that kind of goblin. Shy as can be.
He takes another step away from you.
Her halo spins slightly off her head, its eyes gazing up and below.
It changes.
Miasto Głêbin. It is in constant flux.
The City Below. Celestial tongue.
I'm not too much of a dungeoneer.
Yeah, I've heard.
(Look around.) "Like, right now?"
Day by day, little by little.
What remains constant is the tamed quarters. The halls people wander.
The Coinlord wishes this to be apartments one day.
He wishes to tame it all. This City Below.
He won't be able to. Too many monsters.
Smart. It's prime real-estate.
Would be a lot of trouble. This place is way too esoteric.
Yes.
The Pest Control Guild is busy as is.
Fortune favors the bold. Magistrate Darrow speaks as such.
A cliche saying. Suits him.
I patrol the halls at intervals. The Tolstad tunnels are well-kept due to Lady Sageleaf.
Damn straight.
He looks proud.
However, Tolstad is a strange case. The Pillar acts as a beacon. A center for esoteric activity.
She places a cold, porcelain hand on the stone.
Cleric. Do you know how far it goes?
Dangerous question. She's challenging your intellect.
It will hurt if you admit it.
You've read about the City Below. Recall it.
You know more than this divine harlot will ever learn. Just recall it!
Harlot? That was not very nice.
Is that not what they are called these days?
Oh, how the times have changed.
Understand the dungeon.
I have no idea. (Don't try to understand it.)
She nods. "It goes even deeper. But that is where it meets solid earth."
The City Below is a vast, untamed series of tunnels underneath the City of Norvik.
That you know. This is what you do not know:
It is an esoterically charged leyline conversion point.
Some speculate it is due to the Pillar, some due to the ancient Snail-folk who lived here.
But in the regions where people do not wander en masse- they quickly attract and form esoteric pockets.
It is, for all intents and inclinations, as prone to esotericism as the lands close to the Endless Wastes, far inland.
Yet, for whatever reason, this effect stabilizes once people come around.
It is not understood why.
Hold on, I'm thinking.
The angel glares at you. With a few dozen eyes.
What was the question again?
Right. The depth of the Pillar.
The Pillar of Jor is an esoteric relic, its secrets still not unraveled.
The eight, or four, Pillars present around the Coast each go far down through the Gravity Flip, piercing the Undersea Coast.
Simply tell her it goes down, through the earth, and exists on the other side of the Coast. In Kargamesh.
It goes to... Kargamesh.
She is silent for a beat.
Yes. That is correct.
See?
The Pillar is an endless relic that goes up and down.
It doesn't stop, obviously.
Tell her it is never-ending.
It is never-ending. Obviously.
It goes up. And it goes down. (Point and smirk.)
But that is not what I meant.
Well, she clearly wasn't specific enough.
I see.
Damn it!
Ouch.
Dungeons are a man's business. You're the man here. You're supposed to know about this stuff.
The Pillar of Jor goes into the earth, by the Undercoast Path.
That is the deepest you may travel, before entering the Gravity Flip. I have explored it in pieces. But it is a dangerous place.
Her eyes spin faster.
I will do so.
She nods.
I believe that to be the case as well.
There are reports of a man in yellow delving past this point.
The same man in yellow who was reported at the tea shop incident.
Ah. Yeah, I really need to get down there and check it out.
I knew that.
Thank you for the information, angel.
She nods again.
Her red cape flutters as the angel begins to float out over the abyss.
We will meet below.
The angel begins to descend.
Into the far, far below.
Ettir will join your party below, but only if you do not go down there solo.
Ettir will join your party in the Undercoast Path, but only if you do not go down there solo.
I think I've told you this before- but she freaks me out.
...Sure.
Let's hope so.
Yeah. That's fair enough.
The goblin gives a skeptical glance down below.
You will find her. <shake>Below the Below</shake>.
E-(Look down into the darkness and see nothing.)
